text:
Maria L.: Heads up — we're seeing a gradual nvme IOPS decay in ap-northeast1 over the last 20m. GPU provisioning is getting held because attach latency hits the timeout. Metrics show write_util creeping and long tail latencies. Investigating now, posting iostat and any logs I can grab.

engbot: incident-detect: GPU_ATTACH_FAIL spike in #ap-northeast1 (15m window). AlertID: gpu-attach-8132

Chad K.: can you paste `iostat -x` and `nvme smart-log` from a couple affected hosts? also which fleet job is hitting the region?

Maria L.: pulling a quick sample from 3 hosts, here's `iostat -x 1 3` output from node gn-ape-084: 

```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s rrqm/s wrqm/s  r_await  w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         12.34  245.10   98.21  4096.50   0.00   0.00    0.24     5.12   0.90  89.62
```

Maria L.: nvme smart shows rising warn sectors on 6 hosts, but SMART isn't catastrophic. I also see `io_throttle` events in the node logs around the same timestamps.

Ravi P.: likely cleaner/scrub overlap — we've seen janitor windows causing writeback storms that push nvme into long tail. Check `scrub_backlog` and `janitor_concurrency` for that cohort. If true, easiest mitigation is to cap janitor concurrency for ap-northeast1 and throttle scrub rate.

Alex G.: I noticed a similar pattern last month on older firmware: tail latency spikes from internal GC + scrub leading to attach timeouts. Firmware diff: versions <1.4.3 show bad compaction behavior under sustained small writes. Rolling firmware helps but is noisy. Prefer to throttle janitor first.

Chad K.: quick action: run the host-list script and set attach timeout to 90s for this region while we triage. Command: `./scripts/list-hot-nvme --region ap-northeast1 --since 10m | tee /tmp/hot-hosts`

Maria L.: ran it, output summary: "20 hosts >80% write_util, 6 hosts flagged ECC_WARN, 3 hosts with sporadic nvme reset events". I applied attach timeout=90s on the cluster config (canary 10% now). Holding new GPU attaches for full region until we throttle janitor.

deploybot: rollout-started: attaching config change `attach_timeout=90s` to region ap-northeast1 (canary 10%) — rollout id 7c9d

Ravi P.: 👍 temporary mitigations we should do now: 1) set `janitor_concurrency=2` for ap-northeast1, 2) enable scrub_rate_limit=500MB/s global override for that cohort, 3) schedule a firmware cohort upgrade plan (non-urgent). I'll open PRs for the first two.

Alex G.: +1 on janitor cap. Also add an alert to escalate if write_util >85% for >30m (we hit that threshold fast).

Maria L.: creating an incident runbook ticket with the commands and the sample logs, and scheduling a postmortem review. Will follow up once janitor ramp-down is in place. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Chad K.: tldr: cause = cleaner/scrub overlap + possible older firmware edge. Mitigation = throttle janitor, temporary attach timeout bump, monitor SMART. Follow-up: firmware plan + long-term scrub window tuning.
